messages:
Mike (Partner Eng): Quick heads-up — Datadog marketplace listing needs the embedded observability dashboard + an OTLP example for private deployments. Also EU legal wants copy review. Who can own the checklist?
Sam (Solutions Eng): I can take the dashboard embed assets. Do we have the final panels from Obs PM? :thinking_face:
Ada (Docs): I can do the OTLP sample and short how-to snippet for the marketplace tile. Need an example config that works with our private gateway.
Lina (Legal): FYI I need the marketplace copy + PII checklist by EOD tomorrow for the EU compliance review. If anything mentions customer data flow we should be explicit. @Mike please tag me on the final text. :eyes:
Mike (Partner Eng): Thanks — Sam, can you share the dashboard JSON export to me & Ada? Aim: compact 3-panel view focusing on token latency, model fallbacks, and error rate.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Dropping export here in thread (small snippet) — full file in GDrive.
Sam (Solutions Eng): ```json
{
  "title": "Redwood Inference - Marketplace Compact",
  "panels": ["token_latency", "model_fallbacks", "api_errors"]
}
```
Ada (Docs): Nice. I'll adapt that to the marketplace constraints and include a short `otelcol` snippet for OTLP -> Datadog. Quick draft config: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api: ${DD_API_KEY}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Lina (Legal): Re: copy, keep it privacy-safe: replace any "sends customer text" phrasing with "sends telemetry metadata". Also no guaranteed retention times in public docs.
Mike (Partner Eng): Noted. I'll update the marketplace blurb: "Redwood Inference observability bundle: prebuilt dashboards, OTLP integration, and quickstart for private deployments." Lina — I'll DM you the final copy before submit.
deploy-bot: Notice: marketplace-preview build #492 succeeded for branch `marketplace/dd-embed` — preview link: https://redwood.internal/preview/492
Ada (Docs): Preview link works, dashboard renders in EU region preview. I pushed a small wording change to the blurb and added a short privacy note.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll package the full dashboard JSON + install steps into the marketplace artifact tomorrow morning and tag @Mike.
Mike (Partner Eng): Plan: sam/adad deliverables by 11am UTC tomorrow, Lina review by 5pm EU time, then we submit to Datadog marketplace support channel. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
